records.title: STRIDE: Post-Training LLMs to Reason and Refine Bio-Sequences via Edit Trajectories
records.reason: STRIDE learns executable insertion/deletion/replacement trajectories through supervised and group-based post-training for protein/molecular editing; its improvement is biological edit success/validity, without inference-system efficiency.

records.title: Routing without Forgetting
records.reason: Routing without Forgetting uses energy-based associative retrieval to generate dynamic prompts under online continual learning, evaluated on image classification streams; this addresses continual-learning accuracy rather than LLM inference execution.

records.title: Comparative analysis of dual-form networks for live land monitoring using multi-modal satellite image time series
records.reason: Dual-form attention/retention supports recurrent updates for satellite-image time series and sensor fusion. Its temporal-distance adaptation targets land-monitoring images, with no specific LLM/system-infrastructure application.

records.title: RSR-core: A High-Performance Engine for Low-Bit Matrix-Vector Multiplication
records.reason: RSR-core implements redundant segment reduction as optimized CPU and CUDA kernels for binary/ternary matrix-vector multiplication, with HuggingFace integration and measured LLM token-generation acceleration; this directly improves low-bit inference.

records.title: NCO: A Versatile Plug-in for Handling Negative Constraints in Decoding
records.reason: NCO performs online matching of hard/regex forbidden patterns during LLM decoding, avoiding combined-automaton state explosion and reducing computational overhead while supporting sampling, beam search and soft masks.

records.title: GRIP-VLM: Group-Relative Importance Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models
records.reason: GRIP-VLM formulates visual-token pruning as discrete selection optimized by GRPO and a budget-aware scorer, adapting compression without retraining and reporting inference speedup at equal accuracy.

records.title: The More Popular, The Harder to Forget: Adaptive Popularity for LLM Unlearning
records.reason: AdaPop applies popularity-conditioned gradient pressure and a dual-ascent forget/retain controller to LLM unlearning; leakage and representation retention are the targets, without inference execution optimization.
